verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.browser-use.com that describes the Cloud Agent/Browser APIs and the open-source library, and lists the OpenAPI specs. The docs also point to a managed llms-full.txt bundle under /.well-known (cacheable for 24 hours) and serve pages as markdown (.md), giving agents several machine-readable entry points. missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
